en: "Thank goodness!{w}Huh? Mirco... that sword...?"{w}
"Huh? Wait, did it go all weird?{w}Wha-wha-whaaat!?"{w}
"Wh-what do I do!?{w}Did I break the sword I borrowed from Uncle!?"{w}
note: [JP] = Mirco's Uncle (capitalized as in slices 002/003). Source says [JP] 'borrowed' though the glossary note calls it a gift; translated as written.

en: "No, that is its true form.{w}At last, the sword itself has acknowledged you too."{w}
note: [JP]: 'the sword too' (as well as the people around him).

en: "Board Chair, are you all right?"{w}
"Ah, never mind me...{w}What about the Principal? Is he safe?"{w}{p}"It looked as though he was surrounded by Death Tentacles and blown up spectacularly by their spells..."{w}
"Oh, right, the Principal.{w}Principal, are you all right!!"{w}
"*sizzle*... *smolder*..."{w}
"He's fine!"{w}
note: Deadpan comic beat: Soara reports to the Board Chair.

en: "I see.{w}Then go and fetch the School Nurse.{w}Those youngsters over there could use some treatment as well."{w}
"Ahwoooh! Nnnohhh-heyyy!!"{w}
note: Nonverbal cries of the School Nurse; [JP] read as a drawn-out 'hey'.

en: Once the treatment was done, the School Nurse left.{w}
"Soara, I've caused you a lot of trouble. That was unlike me...{w}Research truly must be done with people one can trust."{w}
"I was mistaken, too.{w}True peace for the land...{w}I didn't know what you had in mind, Board Chair... I'm sorry."{w}
Everyone looked unhappy about it, but this should calm things down a little beneath the castle.{w}
note: [JP] -> 'beneath the castle', matching the 'things underground' lines in slice 059. Subject of [JP] (the defeated contestants) kept as 'everyone'.

en: The Referee is cleaning up after the Spirit Tournament.{w}
"There's something so wistful about the end of a festival, isn't there..."{w}
"The age of the Fire Elemental is comiiing!!"{w}
"Guess the age of the Fire Elemental never came..."{w}
"We're on top form this term!{w}We'll send Ifrit and Phoenix flying!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'we' (the Fire Elemental's side). [JP] -> 'send flying', as in the battle narration 3041.
